recipes.title: Keto Chicken Chorizo Paella
recipes.carbohydrateCaveat: JSON-LD carbohydrate value is a discovery filter only; the registered sourcer must verify total carbs and its serving basis on the public page.
ingredients: 2 tbsp butter  ((plus an extra 2 tbsp for Thermomix® method))
1  dried chorizo (sliced into thin slices, See Note 1)
500 g chicken thigh fillets (cut into cubes, See Note 2)
60 g roasted red peppers (cut into strips)
1.5 tbsp preserved lemon (pith removed, finely minced, See Note 3)
A large pinch of salt flakes and cracked pepper
recipes.description: This Chicken and Chorizo Paella is the perfect keto-friendly dish for the whole family. Simple ingredients, loads of flavour and ready in under 60 minutes!
